Name: Starsaber
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
My first weapon mod. This one almost cost me my sanity, I'm telling you. I had to completely rebuild the entire mod several times, but it - finally - works!

This mod has been tested with 1.6.15, respectively SMAPI 4.2.1.0 / Content Patcher 2.6.1 on Windows 10.

Adds a sword with the name "Starsaber", sold by Marlon in his AdventureShop. The stats of the sword are:
"MinDamage": 250
"MaxDamage": 255
"Knockback": 0.5
"Speed": 8
"Precision": 4
"Defense": 4
"Type": 3
"MineBaseLevel": 5
"MineMinLevel": 3
"AreaOfEffect": 3
"CritChance": 1
"CritMultiplier": 3

Downloads.Description:
This is the same sword, only more expensive to buy.
Now with translation in
de (provided by me)
spanish (provided by Hayato2236)
ru (provided by Kosharik87)

Thank you for your help! :D
